description: This bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for three different language models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—across seven distinct linguistic categories labeled on the horizontal axis as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value,” ranges from 0 to 80 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each category on the horizontal axis contains one or more grouped bars, each representing the contribution of a specific model. The tallest bar is for the “T” category, where the chLSTM model achieves a Shapley value of approximately 80, the mBERT model achieves approximately 60, and the XLM-R model achieves approximately 55. Other notable values include the mBERT model at approximately 10 for the L₁ category, the XLM-R model at approximately 10 for the L₂ category, and the chLSTM model at approximately 10 for the R₁ category. The bars are not sorted by value; they appear in the order of the linguistic categories as listed. The chart includes a legend in the top right corner that associates each color with its respective model.
